properties.description: An acknowledgement is a statement ABOUT the design, not a part of it (crates/reflow2-core/tests/acknowledgement_not_structure.rs) — 5 cases. Acknowledging a disconnected_community CLOSES it and it stays closed on re-detect, which is the livelock: the review Decision is wired GOVERNED_BY into the affected set and the defect id hashes that set, so the acknowledgement used to join the island it acknowledged and mint a new, larger, unaccepted id without limit. Withdrawal still reopens it, and reopens the SAME defect rather than a differently-shaped one. THREE COUNTERWEIGHTS, which are what keep the fix from being a way of silencing a detector: an ORDINARY Decision still counts as structure (excluding all Decisions would pass the livelock case and island everything a real decision governs), a genuinely isolated cluster still fires, and the review record is still stored with its reason and still reachable by GOVERNED_BY from what it acknowledges.
properties.findings: WRITTEN BEFORE THE FIX: the two bug cases failed and all three counterweights passed.
properties.name: An acknowledgement is a statement about the design, not a part of it
